elements.label: Figure 4.2
elements.title: Firms in lower-income countries gain proportionately more sales from adopting voluntary international standards than do firms in more developed countries
elements.content: Line chart type. Y-axis: Sales (log scale), ranging from 17.0 to 17.8. X-axis: Low income, Lower middle income, Upper middle income, High income. Legend: Standard adopted (dark blue line with markers), No standard adopted (light blue line with markers). Data points (approximate values) for Standard adopted: Low income ≈ 17.68, Lower middle income ≈ 17.45, Upper middle income ≈ 17.38, High income ≈ 17.20. Data points for No standard adopted: Low income ≈ 17.32, Lower middle income ≈ 17.22, Upper middle income ≈ 17.14, High income ≈ 17.14. Source: WDR 2025 team, based on World Bank Enterprise Surveys (dashboard), World Bank, https://www.enterprisesurveys.org/en/data. Note: The figure shows the conditional prediction for average log sales by income level and whether firms adopted a voluntary standard, based on a regression of firms' total sales controlling for employment, capital intensity, and sector.
